requirement: Build a tiny in-memory to-do library in Python with these separately testable features, each with pytest tests: (1) add a to-do item; (2) list all items; (3) mark an item complete; (4) delete an item; (5) rename an item; (6) set a due date on an item; (7) set a priority (high, medium or low) on an item; (8) filter items by status (open or complete); (9) search items by text; (10) export all items to JSON; (11) import items from JSON. Validate inputs and raise clear errors for unknown item ids.

spec.name: todo-lib
spec.description: A tiny in-memory to-do library in Python (package `todo`, class `TodoList` in todo/__init__.py or todo.py) with custom exceptions `TodoError` (base, subclass of Exception), `ItemNotFoundError` (subclass of TodoError and KeyError-free; message includes the unknown id) and `ValidationError` (subclass of TodoError and ValueError). Items are represented by a dataclass `TodoItem` with fields: id (int, auto-incremented from 1, never reused), text (str), complete (bool, default False), due_date (datetime.date or None), priority ('high'|'medium'|'low', default 'medium'). All features are methods on `TodoList`, each covered by pytest tests in tests/.

acceptance_criteria.text: add(text) returns a new TodoItem with a unique integer id (starting at 1, incrementing, never reused after deletion), the given text stripped of surrounding whitespace, complete=False, due_date=None, priority='medium'.
add() raises ValidationError if text is not a str or is empty/whitespace-only; no item is created.
list_items() returns all items as a list in insertion (id) order; returns an empty list for an empty TodoList; mutating the returned list does not alter the store.
complete(item_id) marks the item complete=True and returns the updated item; completing an already-complete item is allowed and idempotent.
delete(item_id) removes the item so it no longer appears in list_items(); a second delete of the same id raises ItemNotFoundError.
rename(item_id, new_text) updates the text (stripped) and returns the updated item; raises ValidationError for empty/whitespace/non-str new_text, leaving the old text unchanged.

set_due_date(item_id, due) accepts a datetime.date or an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' string (stored as date) or None (clears the due date); returns the updated item; raises ValidationError for invalid strings (e.g. '2024-13-01', 'tomorrow') or other types.
set_priority(item_id, priority) accepts exactly 'high', 'medium' or 'low' and returns the updated item; raises ValidationError for any other value (e.g. 'urgent', '', None, 'HIGH').
filter_by_status(status) returns only items with status 'open' (complete=False) or 'complete' (complete=True) in id order; raises ValidationError for any other status value.

search(query) returns items whose text contains the query as a case-insensitive substring, in id order; returns an empty list when nothing matches; raises ValidationError if query is not a str or is empty/whitespace-only.
export_json() returns a JSON string representing a list of all items, each object with keys id, text, complete, due_date (ISO string or null), priority; an empty list exports as '[]'.

import_json(data) parses a JSON string in the export format and adds the items to the list, returning the number of items imported; imported ids are preserved, and subsequently added items get an id greater than any existing id. A round trip export_json -> import_json into a new TodoList yields equal items.

import_json raises ValidationError (and leaves the list unchanged, i.e. atomic) for invalid JSON, a non-list top level, items that are not objects, missing/invalid fields (empty text, bad priority, non-bool complete, bad due_date, non-int id), or ids that duplicate existing ids or each other. Missing optional fields complete, due_date, priority default to False, None, 'medium'.

Every method taking an item_id (complete, delete, rename, set_due_date, set_priority) raises ItemNotFoundError with a message containing the id when the id does not exist; a non-int item_id (including bool) raises ValidationError.
Each feature has pytest tests in tests/ that pass with `pytest`, and the library uses only the Python standard library.

tasks.title: Project scaffold, models, errors and add()
tasks.description: Create package `todo` with TodoItem dataclass, TodoError/ItemNotFoundError/ValidationError, TodoList with internal store and id counter, add(), and an internal _get(item_id) helper that validates id type (non-int/bool -> ValidationError) and raises ItemNotFoundError with the id in the message. Add tests/test_add.py and tests for _get behaviour via public API where possible.
acceptance_criteria: add returns TodoItem with defaults and stripped text
ids start at 1, increment, and are not reused after deletion (tested once delete exists, or via counter)
add with '', '   ', or non-str raises ValidationError and creates nothing
ItemNotFoundError and ValidationError importable from todo; hierarchy as described

tasks.description: Implement list_items() returning a copy list of items in insertion order. Tests in tests/test_list.py.
acceptance_criteria: mutating returned list does not affect the store

acceptance_criteria: marks item complete and returns it

tasks.title: delete()
tasks.description: Implement delete(item_id). Tests in tests/test_delete.py.
acceptance_criteria: new add after delete gets a fresh, never-reused id

acceptance_criteria: text updated and stripped, item returned
empty/whitespace/non-str raises ValidationError and text unchanged

tasks.title: set_due_date()
tasks.description: Implement set_due_date(item_id, due) accepting date, ISO string, or None. Tests in tests/test_due_date.py.

tasks.title: set_priority()
tasks.description: Implement set_priority(item_id, priority). Tests in tests/test_priority.py.
acceptance_criteria: 'urgent', '', None, 'HIGH' raise ValidationError and priority unchanged

tasks.title: filter_by_status()
tasks.description: Implement filter_by_status(status). Tests in tests/test_filter.py.
acceptance_criteria: results in id order; empty list if none

tasks.title: search()
tasks.description: Implement search(query) case-insensitive substring match. Tests in tests/test_search.py.
acceptance_criteria: case-insensitive substring match returns matching items in id order

tasks.title: export_json()
tasks.description: Implement export_json() returning JSON string of list of item dicts. Tests in tests/test_export.py.
acceptance_criteria: due_date serialized as ISO string or null

tasks.title: import_json() happy path and round trip
tasks.description: Implement import_json(data) for valid input with defaults for optional fields, preserving ids, updating the id counter, returning count. Tests in tests/test_import.py.
acceptance_criteria: ids preserved and later add() gets id greater than max existing
export -> import into a new TodoList yields equal items

tasks.title: import_json() validation and atomicity
tasks.description: Add full validation to import_json: validate everything before mutating the store. Tests in tests/test_import_validation.py.
acceptance_criteria: invalid JSON, non-list top level, non-object items raise ValidationError
empty text, bad priority, non-bool complete, bad due_date, non-int/bool id, missing id or text raise ValidationError
duplicate ids within the data or against existing items raise ValidationError
after any failure the list is unchanged (atomic)
